about: The evangelium of the formulary “Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, the Angel Gabriel was sent by God into a city of Galilee whose name is Nazareth, to a virgin promised in marriage to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house; and the name of the virgin was Mary. And the angel, having come in to her, said: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you; blessed are you among women.
